faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Is this the same as the real exam?
faq.a1: The layout, timing, question types and rules follow the computer-delivered IELTS Academic and the Digital SAT. Content is written by our team; it is a practice test, not an official certificate.
faq.a2: An AI grader scores each task on the four IELTS criteria and gives a band per criterion with written feedback. Results arrive within a few minutes of submitting.
faq.q3: Can I take the test on my phone?
faq.a3: You can sign up, pay and read your results on a phone. The exam itself runs on a laptop or desktop, like the real computer-based test.
faq.q4: Will I get the same test twice?
faq.a4: No. Every mock you start is one you have not taken before.
faq.q5: Which currencies can I pay in?
faq.a5: UZS, USD and EUR. Prices include taxes.
faq.a6: Your answers are saved as you go. The timer keeps running, as in the real exam; when the connection returns, you continue where you stopped.
